column2: Working tree: your files. Index (staging area): what the next commit will contain (git add). Commit: a saved snapshot.
Creates a branch called name at the current commit and switches to it.
<<<<<<< your side, ======= separator, >>>>>>> their side. Edit the file to the right result, delete the markers, git add, commit.
The first discards working-tree changes to f; the second unstages f (keeps the changes in the working tree).
The first is UTC midnight (shows as 30 Sept west of UTC); the second is local midnight. Months are 0-based in the constructor.
Same result on every run: no randomness, no real clock, no network, no shared state between tests.
toBe: Object.is (same primitive value or same object). toEqual: deep structural equality.
One line per commit, all branches, drawn as a graph: the fastest way to see where you are.
